data.title: Court payment order (Mahnbescheid) from Amtsgericht Beispielcoburg
data.summary: The Mahngericht für Bayern at Amtsgericht Beispielcoburg issued a court payment order (Mahnbescheid) against Theresa Beispielhuber on behalf of Exempel Fitnesswelt GmbH & Co. KG for unpaid gym membership fees from March to July 2026, plus fees and costs, totaling €364.70. The order was delivered to her personally on 20 November 2026.
data.explanation: A Mahnbescheid is a court order based only on the claimant's own statements — the court has not checked whether the claim is actually justified. You now have a choice, within the period shown by the app: if you think the debt is owed, you can pay the amount plus interest directly to the claimant; if you disagree with it in whole or in part, you can file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Mahngericht, ideally using the enclosed form. If you do neither, the claimant can ask the court for an enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid), which allows measures like a bank account seizure. If you dispute the claim, consider getting legal advice quickly given the short deadline.
